description:
SET A NEW PULSE FOR HEALTHCARE!

We are looking for a Senior Agents Platform Engineer to join the ML Platform (TIGER) team in AI & Machine Learning.

Your mission will be to build the platform that lets every feature team at Doctolib declare an agent once - and get a production-grade, secure, and compliant AI agent by default. You will work on the foundational layer that powers Consultation Assistant, Phone Assistant, Health Companion, and more: a shared agent runtime, a unified GenAI gateway, and the observability and evaluation infrastructure that makes it all trustworthy - contributing directly to safer, faster, and more reliable AI for patients and care teams across Europe.

Working in the tech team at Doctolib means building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

- Own the agent manifest and registry - design the single declarative specification (skills, tools, memory, model, guardrails, sandbox, security) that wires any new agent into the full platform automatically, triggerable from product surfaces, other agents (A2A), schedules, or workflows

- Own the GenAI gateway end to end (built on LiteLLM) - manage routing (including KV-cache-aware routing), failover, metering, cost attribution, reserved-capacity pooling, and guardrails across self-hosted (vLLM) and managed providers, serving several hundred million requests per month

- Operate the infrastructure for long-running, streaming agent interactions - build production-grade reliability for SSE/WebSocket connections, queueing and retries, human-in-the-loop approvals, and snapshot/resume, in a sandboxed execution environment consistent with our existing application runtime

- Build feature-flagged, progressive rollout for prompts, models, and configs - including an emergency kill-switch and the audit trail that lets agents act safely on sensitive healthcare data

- Own reliability for the agents platform end to end - define SLOs, lead on-call and incident response, and build runbooks including provider failover for the GenAI gateway

- Build the observability and evaluation layer - online traces and logs, offline evals (LLM-as-judge plus patient and practitioner simulators) gating CI, and the compliance-grade audit trail for health data

- Validate the platform by shipping one or two reference agents yourself before product teams adopt it, and advise feature teams on agent architecture trade-offs

- Have 5+ years of software engineering experience, including hands-on production experience building or operating LLM-based agent systems (Google ADK or similar), with a solid understanding of agent design patterns: planning/reflection loops, tool calling, state and memory management, multi-agent coordination, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints

- Are fluent in English

title: Finance Analyst
description:
About Sparkfund

Sparkfund is the utility services company unlocking capacity on the grid. Through its Distributed Capacity Procurement (DCP) model, Sparkfund enables utilities, energy majors, and large-load customers to deploy front-of-the-meter batteries and gensets as distribution infrastructure. By adding targeted capacity exactly where and when the grid needs it most, DCP helps meet demand, support reliability, and put downward pressure on rates. Sparkfund supports program design, grid value assessment, asset host engagement, and value chain management to ensure on-time, on-budget deployment with maximum system value and lowest cost.

With more than 3,200 projects deployed across 43 states and more than 300MW of energized assets constructed, Sparkfund is transforming customer-sited assets into a valuable portfolio resource for the benefit of our society. To learn more about Sparkfund , visit sparkfund.com.

FINANCE ANALYST
Department: Finance
Reports To: Director, Corporate Finance
Location: Remote (United States); preference for candidates in the New York City metro area or elsewhere on the East Coast
Employment Type: Full-Time, Exempt
Travel: Occasional; company gatherings and team meetings
About the Role
Sparkfund prices and structures its Distributed Capacity Procurement deals using a set of programmatic pricing models, and this role is responsible for both sides of that work: building the ad hoc project finance models a deal needs when it falls outside the existing templates, and keeping the standing programmatic models accurate as cost, revenue, timing, and financing assumptions shift. You'll work from our existing model library, but you'll also be expected to build new models from scratch when a deal structure calls for something the templates don't cover.
The work sits between Finance and the teams closest to the deals. You will partner with Business Development, Program, and Project teams to source the assumptions that feed a model, test them against the underlying data, and flag anything that doesn't hold up before it reaches a pricing output. You will also translate model output into language deal teams can use when they negotiate. You will report to the Director of Corporate Finance. Success in this role looks like a maintained set of pricing models that are accurate and able tohold up under review from Finance leadership and deal counterparts.

ABOUT THE PROGRAM

The Nu AI Core Summer Internship Program is a research-focused internship for PhD students working at the frontier of artificial intelligence and machine learning.

Over about 12 weeks, interns collaborate with engineers, applied scientists, and researchers on complex AI challenges. Each intern leads an end-to-end research or applied AI project that combines research methods with large-scale production environments.

The program builds long-term relationships between industry and academia and with emerging AI research talent.

- Location model: Remote, with one in-person week at Nu's Palo Alto office in Silicon Valley, fully covered by us.

- Dedicated research mentor

- Ownership of a scoped AI research project

- Access to large-scale datasets and compute infrastructure

- Research talks and technical seminars

- Final research presentation to leadership and AI teams

RESEARCH AREAS

Interns may work on projects related to:

- Machine learning and deep learning

description:
We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems - robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

• Help create and deliver production-ready, scalable and high-quality learning models and associated algorithms

title: Senior TA Operations Specialist
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

The role

You will be the hands-on operator behind our Workday work and a key resolver for our core recruiting systems. In the near term you will help test and implement Workday for Talent Acquisition, then support it and improve its processes after go-live. Alongside that, you will resolve issues across Greenhouse and ChartHop for the core processes that recruiters and coordinators depend on, such as backfills and conversions. You will spot patterns in what breaks and fix the process, not just the ticket.

What you will do

Workday testing and implementation

• Partner with the Workday project team and TA stakeholders to document requirements, write and run test scenarios, and track and retest defects.

• Coordinate user acceptance testing with recruiters, coordinators, and business partners, and make sure issues are resolved before go-live.

• Validate data and process flows between Workday and our other TA systems, and help prepare cutover, training materials, and communications.

Workday support and improvement after go-live

• Be a first point of escalation for Workday questions and issues from TA, resolving what you can and routing the rest with clear context.

• Iterate on processes after launch: gather feedback, find friction, and propose and test improvements.

• Keep process documentation and job aids current as configuration and workflows change.

Core systems resolution (Greenhouse and ChartHop)

• Resolve system issues that affect core processes, including backfills, conversions, and requisition and headcount alignment between systems.

• Investigate data and sync discrepancies, fix the root cause where you can, and escalate with a clear summary where you cannot.

• Handle support tickets and requests with consistent quality and response times.

Continuous improvement

• Track recurring issues and questions, identify root causes, and recommend changes to configuration, process, or training.

• Partner with the enablement team so recurring questions become better training and guidance.

• Help define process around outcomes and actual tool usage, so the tools get used correctly and consistently.

How the role evolves

Early on, your time is split between Workday testing and implementation and core systems resolution. After go-live, the balance shifts toward Workday support and process improvement, while core systems resolution continues. As the Workday footprint grows, this role is a natural path toward leading larger systems projects, initiatives, and process improvement for TA to meet increasingly complex and scaling business needs.

title: Staff Network Engineer (AI Infrastructure)
description:
As a Staff Network Engineer at vCluster Labs , you aren't just configuring switches; you are building the automation logic that configures them. AI Clouds run on InfiniBand and high-speed Ethernet fabrics that most teams still wire up by hand, one customer at a time. You will build the automation that turns that fabric into repeatable provisioning logic. You start in a small R&D group alongside our CTO and grow into owning this area as it becomes a core part of our platform.
As a Staff Network Engineer, your role will include:

• Fabric automation: You will design and build the systems that automatically provision and configure NVIDIA switches and InfiniBand fabrics, including integration with NVIDIA UFM. Manual, per-customer switch setup is the thing you are replacing.

• Network config management and sync: You will build the control loop that keeps switch, VLAN, and VXLAN state consistent with what our platform intends, detects drift, and reconciles it safely in production.

• NAT gateway and L4 load balancing: You will build the gateway and load balancing layer that tenant clusters depend on for connectivity, with failover designed in from day one rather than bolted on later.

• Scale and failure engineering: You will define how our network layer behaves at large scale: BGP route table limits, convergence, failover, and what happens when a link, switch, or gateway dies under real AI workloads.

• Customer Zero for AI networking: You will run your automation on real AI Cloud environments, bring back what breaks, and turn hard-won operational lessons into product behavior our customers never have to think about.

• Technical direction: You will help decide what we build versus integrate with partner solutions, write the design and requirements docs, and set the standards for how networking works across vCluster products.

This role could be a fit for you if you bring:

• You have built network automation, not just operated networks: You have shipped software that configures switches, routers, or load balancers programmatically, ideally as part of a product or internal platform other teams relied on.

• NVIDIA networking experience: Hands-on work with NVIDIA UFM, NVIDIA Spectrum or Quantum switches, Cumulus Linux, or NVUE, including programming against their APIs.

• Deep fabric fundamentals: Strong command of InfiniBand, VLAN, VXLAN and EVPN, and BGP, including how they behave and fail at production scale.

• Production scale scars: You have run networks at real production scale, seen them break, and helped fix the root cause with automation rather than runbooks.

• Software engineering ability: You write production code in Go or Python, use version control and code review as a matter of course, and think of network config as code.

Bonus points for:

• AI networking depth: Experience tuning fabrics for GPU training or inference workloads, such as RoCEv2, congestion control, rail-optimized topologies, or Spectrum-X.

• AI Cloud or hyperscaler background: You helped build network automation at a GPU cloud, hyperscaler, or large CDN.

• Load balancer and gateway internals: Experience building L4 load balancers or NAT gateways, including with eBPF/XDP or DPDK.

• Open source: Contributions to networking or Kubernetes projects such as SONiC, FRRouting, Cilium, or MetalLB.

We're the #1 platform for AI infrastructure, trusted by the world's fastest-growing AI cloud builders. We're a venture-backed startup that's raised over $28M from top-tier investors including Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, and DoorDash), and we're in a hyper-growth phase looking for motivated people to join our team. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe with a remote-first culture.

Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

About the Team
The Fraud team is building the largest network of trusted identities in the US. We help customers onboard legitimate users and stop bad actors before they cause downstream harm. Our products span the risk lifecycle: Identity Verification and Monitor for onboarding and compliance, and Protect, our fraud intelligence platform.

 

We are extending that network to AI agents. Agents are starting to open accounts, link accounts, move money, and transfer between wallets for consumers. The protocols forming around them standardize how an agent identifies itself and what it may do, and leave the question of whether to trust it to the business on the receiving end. Agent Trust, our Know Your Agent (KYA) product, answers it, on top of the identity, consent, and risk infrastructure Plaid already runs.

 

You will take over Agent Trust: the decision on whether an action an AI agent takes on a financial account can be trusted. You will define how Plaid identifies agents, verifies the people behind them, and evaluates what they are authorized to do, and how that connects to portable identity, reusable KYC, and consumer permissions. You will sell that decision to financial institutions and to Plaid customers, and you will carry Plaid’s requirements into the standards bodies shaping this space, with the fraud engineering and data teams behind you.

- Own the vision, strategy, roadmap, and OKRs for Agent Trust. Decide what Plaid offers, to whom, and how it is packaged and priced.

- Define how Plaid identifies agents, verifies the humans behind them, and evaluates what they are allowed to do, for new accounts and existing ones.

- Connect Agent Trust to portable identity, reusable KYC, and consumer permission management, with the product teams that own those surfaces.

- Work directly with financial institutions and Plaid customers as the product expert: discovery, design partnerships, and GTM enablement.

- Represent Plaid’s product requirements in the industry groups and protocol working groups writing the specs for agent identity and authorization, with Partnerships and Legal.

- Partner with data science and engineering on what the product needs: signals, labels, success metrics, and the requirements that tie them together.

- Track record of growing a new product line, from early design partners and first customers to repeatable sales

- Experience building with and selling to enterprise customers or financial institutions

- Clear writing, and the ability to translate between protocol engineers, data scientists, GTM, and executives

title: Technical Director, Internet Storm Center (ISC)
description:
About SANS
Founded in 1989, SANS Institute (SANS) began as a cooperative research and education organization. Over the next 25 years, it grew to become the most trusted and widely recognized provider of information security training and certification in the world. Today, SANS has served more than 300,000 cybersecurity professionals around the world, with more than 60,000 earning Global Information Assurance Certification (GIAC) security certifications-the leading certification that provides assurance to employers that their people and prospective hires can do the job.
At the heart of SANS is a community of practitioners, from auditors and network administrators to CISOs, who share their lessons learned and collaborate on solutions to the challenges they face. These experts, working across corporations, government agencies, and universities, come together to support and strengthen the global information security community.
Why SANS?
At SANS, our culture is defined by three pillars: Mission, Brand, and People.

• Our Mission is to hire people who understand the importance fighting against cybersecurity threats.

• Our Brand reflects a commitment to delivering the highest quality training.

• Our People are grounded in a culture of fairness, honesty, customer focus, and a pragmatic approach.

What You’ll Achieve at SANS

The SANS Internet Storm Center (ISC) is a community-driven cyber threat detection network that serves as an early warning system for the global cybersecurity community. Built on data and analysis contributed by volunteers and sensors around the world, the ISC helps defenders everywhere understand emerging threats and respond with confidence.

ISC Leadership

• Coordinate the daily publication schedule and contributions from ISC volunteer handlers.

• Oversee students interns for ISC from SANS.edu

• Produce technical analyses and content for ISC publications as needed.

• Serve as the primary media contact for the Internet Storm Center.

Cybersecurity Thought Leadership

• Host or contribute to the Internet Storm Center Daily Podcast.

• Contribute technical content and analysis to SANS NewsBites and @Risk newsletters.

• Maintain vulnerability intelligence systems used to identify, prioritize, and communicate emerging cybersecurity threats.

• Perform other related duties as assigned.

• Demonstrated expertise in cybersecurity research, threat intelligence, or security operations.

• Strong technical background in cybersecurity, including applied security research and incident response.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience producing technical publications for professional audiences.

• Demonstrated leadership in the cybersecurity community through research, publications, presentations, or other recognized contributions.

description:
💼 E-Commerce and Wholesale Operations Specialist (AI-Forward)
🌎 Open to Latin America: This role is open to candidates based in Latin America. ​
🏠 Remote
About Our Client
Our client is a fast-moving global fashion distribution company that buys large lots of brand inventory and sells through its own DTC site, multiple marketplace channels, and a wholesale sales team. With a broad brand portfolio and a multi-channel sales operation, accuracy in pricing, product data, and images has a direct impact on revenue.
About the Role
We're looking for an E-Commerce and Wholesale Operations Specialist (AI-Forward) to be the operations backbone of the business. You'll centralize and manage product data, keep listings live and accurate, build wholesale offer sheets, support daily sales operations, and over time help build the CRM and automation infrastructure that ties it all together.
This is one role covering five connected areas: product management, e-commerce, wholesale, sales operations, and CRM and automation. The listing, wholesale, and sales admin work starts from day one, while the CRM and automation work develops as you build trust and context. We need someone highly competent, proactive, and detail-obsessed who is genuinely skilled with AI tools and takes ownership of a wide scope without needing tasks delegated one by one.
Responsibilities

• Centralize product data, images, inventory, and pricing from vendor files and the ERP into one accurate system, managing variants, UPCs, size breakdowns, and pricing in spreadsheets

• Source accurate product images and MSRPs from trusted sources, and edit and clean up images using AI tools

• Keep inventory in sync as it flows from the ERP through Shopify to each channel

• Create and maintain Shopify and marketplace listings, keeping them current, accurate, and consistent across all active channels

• Build and update wholesale offer sheets with images, pricing, quantities, and size breakdowns, tailored to specific customers

• Pull cost pricing from the ERP and calculate pricing within target and minimum margin parameters

• Support daily sales administration, including pipeline updates, reporting, and coordination between departments

• Track sales rep activity across the ERP, the sales order management platform, and email, maintaining an accurate CRM or activity dashboard

• Run and improve the AI workflow that turns daily recaps into a morning sales meeting template

• Over time, help build and maintain CRM infrastructure and reporting dashboards across e-commerce and wholesale

• Identify and automate repetitive workflows to reduce manual work and errors

What We're Looking For

• Highly competent and reliable, with a track record of ownership and accuracy on pricing, data, and product information

• Proactive by nature, spotting what needs doing without waiting for tasks to be delegated

• Strong systems thinker who can build and improve operational processes

• Genuinely skilled with AI tools, including building internal AI workflows and automations, working with APIs, and using AI for image editing and data work

• Fast and accurate in Google Sheets or Excel with advanced spreadsheet skills

• Fluent written and spoken English for daily communication with a US-based team, primarily over WhatsApp and video calls

• Comfortable building rapport with an in-office team through daily calls and regular check-ins in a remote setup

• Based in Latin America

Nice to Have

• Experience with Shopify, an ERP system, or marketplace platforms

• Experience building dashboards or lightweight CRMs

• Prior experience supporting a sales team with administrative and data management work

• Interest in fashion, streetwear, or sneakers

Work Schedule

•
100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive

• This position operates on a full-time basis, with dedicated hours to ensure alignment with the team and delivery of quality work

• Availability Monday through Friday, 9 AM to 5

title: Staff Product Analyst, Driver Supply
description:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

Relay delivers 400,000 parcels a day through people who don't work for us: van drivers who choose their own shifts, local shops that hold parcels, and couriers who take them to the door. We went from 3,000 parcels a day in London to 400,000 across the UK in under three years.

Delivery companies have always bought capacity by guesswork. Book too few drivers and parcels wait; book too many and you pay for empty vans. Most carriers accept that waste as the price of being reliable. Relay is building a marketplace where it isn't. You can't schedule drivers. You can only design what's on offer, and measure what happens.

Every part of our network runs on decisions. The next two years are about building the systems that make them well, and proving they do. Engineering and operational research build what you design.

MARKETPLACE HIGHLIGHTS

- You own decision-making, not the model: you decide what Marketplace changes on booking, matching and shifts, and recommend on pay. Our scientists' models and experiments feed your calls, and the squad lead acts on them.

- Drivers choose when to work. What makes a shift worth booking early, and how do you prove what works when a clean experiment isn't possible?

- Every booked shift is paid, used or not, and every unserved route means late parcels. Where should each area sit between the two, and what would let the network get there on its own?

- Local shops hold our parcels while running their own businesses. Where does the network need more of them, what should a shop be paid, and how would you see a closed shop coming?

- A whole area, not a slice: no playbook, and the result is on the street the next morning.

- Analytics at the front, not in support: the squad's roadmap follows the analysis, in a data team of about 30 across analytics, operational research and data science.

THE OPPORTUNITY

As a Staff Product Analyst, Driver Supply at Relay, you'll:

- Decide which Marketplace problems are real and which only look real, before anyone builds a fix.

- Design how Marketplace decides: which signals count, and what good looks like for booking, matching and pay.

- Tell the squad lead what to change and what to stop, and get a decision.

- Build the thing that decides: data applications, monitors and alerts, not decks, using Claude and agents to ship your own tools.

- Go and look when the data and the street disagree: the sort centre, the van, the shop.

- Get the missing data built, and prove whether each change worked. In a year, Marketplace's booking and pay decisions run on a system you designed.

WE'RE LOOKING FOR CANDIDATES WHO…

- Have owned the decisions a matching, pricing or incentive model fed, in a two-sided marketplace or gig platform, rather than building the model itself.

- Have seen their work acted on: a leader changed a plan, a team adopted your method, or engineers built what you asked for.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Machine Learning
description:
Senior Software Engineer | Autoplanner | Hybrid Working | London

Introduction:  

We are Ocado Group, and we're bringing world-class automation to online grocery. Our Ocado Smart Platform (OSP) combines cutting-edge robotics, AI, and IoT within our advanced CFCs (Customer Fulfilment Centres). We've mastered the single pick, transforming online delivery for our global partners. Join us and be part of a team pushing the boundaries of retail technology. 

About the Role :

As a Senior Software Engineer in the Autoplanner team, you will own the software engineering that brings our data science and machine learning products into live production. Autoplanner builds AI-powered systems that unify planning across global warehouses and last-mile assets, delivering globally optimized plans that maximize profit and minimize lateness. You will act as the engineering partner to our data scientists, ensuring our systems remain robust, highly scalable, and efficient as we roll out to more international retail partners. Our services are mostly Python, but we use Java where a service integrates closely with the Ocado Smart Platform, to take advantage of its shared tooling.

In this role, you will write typed, well-tested Python and oversee cloud-based data applications from end to end. You will contribute to core architectural decisions, improve CI/CD pipelines, and raise engineering standards across the team through pairing, code reviews, and shared tooling. Additionally, you will harness AI coding tools in production while maintaining a strong emphasis on engineering discipline, system performance, and high-quality software craft.

Key Responsibilities:

• Develop and maintain data- and ML-driven, cloud-based applications.

• Build and maintain robust APIs and data contracts for data science teams and broader Ocado systems.

• Manage cloud deployments and continuously improve CI/CD pipelines across diverse AWS environments.

• Package, version, serve, and monitor machine learning models in live production environments.

• Drive architecture decisions across repository, application, and system levels, documenting them as Architecture Decision Records (ADRs).

• Partner directly with data scientists to transition advanced algorithms and models into scalable production systems.

• Collaborate with software engineers across Ocado Technology to integrate applications within the Ocado Smart Platform (OSP).

• Elevate engineering practices across the team through pairing, code reviews, shared tooling, and responsible AI agent integration.

• Share in on-call and production support responsibilities for critical live operational services.

What We’re Looking For:

• Proven experience as a Senior Software Engineer owning end-to-end production Python services.

• Extensive background building data-intensive cloud applications, preferably asynchronous, event-driven, or queue-based architectures.

• Strong practical knowledge of AWS and/or GCP identity, networking, and messaging services.

• Solid software design capabilities, including defining system boundaries and crafting high-level architectures.

• Rigorous testing and delivery discipline, encompassing integration testing and modern CI/CD practices.

• Hands-on MLOps experience, specifically in packaging, serving, and monitoring ML models in production.

• Practical experience using AI coding agents on production codebases, with a sharp judgment on validating and verifying AI-generated output.

title: Mainframe Developer

Short Description:
We are undertaking a modernization initiative to replace an aging eligibility platform with a new statewide eligibility system (EDEN).
Complete Description:
We are undertaking a modernization initiative to replace an aging eligibility platform with a new statewide eligibility system (EDEN). As part of this effort, the legacy Child Support Enforcement system (ICAR) must continue to exchange critical data with the new platform through a series of file-based interfaces and batch processes.
The Mainframe Developer will play a key role in supporting the integration and transition between the legacy child support system and the new eligibility platform. This position will focus on analysis, development, testing, deployment, and support of mainframe applications and interfaces that enable seamless data exchange during the modernization effort.
Position Summary:
The Mainframe Developer will design, develop, modify, test, and support mainframe programs and batch processes that facilitate integration between the legacy Child Support Enforcement system (ICAR) and the new Eligibility Determination system (EDEN). The resource will work closely with business analysts, architects, testers, and technical teams to implement interface updates, maintain data integrity, and support the transition from legacy data sources to modernized eligibility services.
Key Responsibilities:
Mainframe Application Development

• Develop, enhance, and maintain COBOL and JCL programs that process interface files between ICAR and EDEN.

• Modify file layouts, data mappings, transformation logic, and validation routines based on business and technical requirements.

• Enhance batch processing workflows, GDG structures, and VSAM datasets to support evolving integration requirements.

• Support modernization efforts by replacing legacy eligibility data sources with EDEN-derived data.

• Maintain and troubleshoot existing production processes and interfaces.

Technical Analysis and Design

• Translate business and functional requirements into technical design specifications.

• Analyze existing mainframe applications and integration points to determine impacts of system changes.

• Modify and support applications that interact with IDMS databases, including schema and subschema navigation.

• Perform detailed record-level and field-level analysis of inbound and outbound interfaces.

• Identify dependencies, integration touchpoints, and risks associated with parallel operation of legacy and modern systems.

• Create and maintain technical documentation, process flows, program specifications, and interface designs.

Testing and Quality Assurance

• Develop unit test scenarios and execute comprehensive testing of mainframe applications and batch jobs.

• Support system, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing activities.

• Investigate and resolve defects identified during testing cycles.

• Validate end-to-end data processing and file exchanges between systems.

• Ensure data quality, processing accuracy, and compliance with business requirements.

Deployment and Operational Support

• Create and maintain JCL, procedures (PROCs), scheduling definitions, and operational documentation.

• Support implementation, migration, and production deployment activities.

• Assist with cutover planning and execution during modernization milestones.

• Troubleshoot production incidents, file processing failures, and data discrepancies.

• Develop operational runbooks, monitoring procedures, and post-deployment support documentation.

Collaboration and Communication

• Partner with project managers, business analysts, developers, testers, and business stakeholders.

• Participate in design reviews, technical walkthroughs, sprint planning, and status meetings.

• Communicate technical risks, issues, dependencies, and recommendations proactively.

title: Senior Sales Recruiter
description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Global Talent Acquisition 

This Is Not a Back-Office Recruiting Role

This is a front-line, high-impact role for recruiters who know how to win, who can partner with senior leaders, and who want their work to matter beyond filling seats. At Axon, we don’t recruit for “jobs.” We recruit for a mission: to protect life, build trust, and create safer communities. We move fast, we think big, and we expect our recruiters to bring swagger, boldness, and grit to the table. If you’re the kind of recruiter who thrives on hard searches, strong opinions, data-backed decisions, and telling leaders the truth -you’ll fit right in.

Your Impact

As a Sales Recruiter at Axon, you will own full-cycle recruiting for high-impact sales roles that directly fuel our growth and mission. You’ll act as a talent advisor, not an order-taker-shaping role profiles, influencing hiring decisions, and building pipelines that scale with the business. You’ll partner with driven sales leaders, operate with urgency and accountability, and help raise the bar for what “great” looks like across our sales organization. Recruiting here is a team sport, but ownership matters-and you’ll have plenty of it.

This role is based out of our Seattle, WA office and  follows a hybrid schedule. We rely on in-person collaboration and ask that team members work onsite Tuesdays through Fridays, with the flexibility to work remotely on Mondays, unless there is an approved workplace accommodation. We believe that connection fuels innovation, and our in-office culture is designed to foster meaningful teamwork, mentorship, and shared success.

What You’ll Do

Location: Seattle, WA
Reports to: Director, Talent Acquisition

•
Own the full lifecycle recruiting process-from proactive sourcing through close-for sales roles across the business.

•
Partner closely with sales leaders to define what excellence actually looks like , not just what’s written on a req.

•
Build intentional, future-ready talent pipelines across our go-to-market organization-including Account Executives, Strategic Customer Success Managers, Key Account Executives, Sales Development Representatives, and more.

•
Use data and market insight to guide decisions, challenge assumptions, and improve hiring outcomes.

•
Source aggressively and creatively using LinkedIn Recruiter, Indeed, Greenhouse, and whatever else gets results.

•
Continuously test, measure, and improve recruiting strategies, tools, and workflows.

•
Deliver a candidate experience that reflects Axon’s brand-direct, respectful, fast, and human.

•
Build trust with hiring leaders by being decisive, candid, and solutions-oriented.

•
Drive inclusive hiring by proactively sourcing diverse talent and embedding equity throughout the hiring process.

•
Juggle multiple high-priority searches without dropping the ball-or your standards.

What You Bring

•
5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience (corporate required; agency experience a plus)

•
Proven success recruiting sales or revenue-generating roles in fast-paced environments

•
Strong sourcing chops and a track record of building high-quality pipelines

•
Comfort managing high-volume, high-visibility requisitions

•
Confidence to influence senior stakeholders and push back when needed

•
Sharp instincts, strong judgment, and the ability to move fast without being sloppy

•
A data-informed mindset-you know what to measure and why it matters
